title: too small for my needs.
text: too small for my needs.. Smaller than I expected. Was wanting something a lot bigger. Should have paid more attention to measurements. Good quality bag but too small for the need I had in mind. Can I buy one of yours in a larger size? I'd buy again if bigger.

features: ULTRA SAFE LEAK-PROOF LINING: Keeps liquids inside the bag making it waterproof and easy to clean, keeping spills in the bag and not on you or your car.
THERMAL INSULATION: Keeps food HOT or COLD. Great for transporting frozen foods and hot food from the grocery store to your home or kitchen. Keeps hot Items hot and cold Items cold

MULTI USE: Thes ebags are great for grocery shopping, taking home hot or cold food, transporting cold beverages, picnics and much more. Perfect for food delivery, uber eats, postmates,

description: These heavy duty insulated grocery bags are made from 700 denier polyster and they are fully lined with PEVA material to create a waterproof seal. Not only are the heavy duty insulated grocery bags great for grocery shopping, but they are also perfect for picnics, for the beach, pool side, for your lunch and more. Nice, large capacity with heavy, wide, poly web handles makes this a durable, strong bag that you will reach for time and time again.
